review_notes: I read the whole file. It introduces no new definitions or structures. It has one private lemma and four existence theorems. They are built on `TauCeti.moreauYosidaResolvent`, `moreauYosida`, `potentialEnergy`, `WassersteinSpace` and `IsTightMeasureSet`. These come from the library's own gradient-flow files, other Tau Ceti files and Mathlib. The file does not define its own tightness, narrow-convergence or lower-semicontinuity notion. It reuses `comap (↑) (𝓝 ...)`, `Metric.isBounded_iff_ediam_ne_top`, `LowerSemicontinuous` and `liminf`. The hypotheses `hφ` and `htight` are repeated verbatim across three theorems. That is a duplication of statement text, not a competing concept, and the rubric excludes it. I did not search for a Mathlib counterpart to the narrow-lsc hypothesis. I found no evidence of an avoidable competing version of an existing Mathlib concept.
